about.full:
Hi, I'm **Anmol Singh**, a B.Tech Computer Science Engineering student at **Hi-Tech Institute of Engineering & Technology**, affiliated with AKTU.

I enjoy learning new technologies and turning ideas into practical software projects. My journey started with programming fundamentals and gradually moved towards full-stack web development, backend development, APIs, databases, and Artificial Intelligence.

I primarily work with *HTML*, *CSS*, *JavaScript*, *React*, *Python*, *Flask*, *Django*, *Django REST Framework*, *MySQL*, *SQL*, *Tailwind CSS*, and *Git*. I also work with REST APIs and have been exploring AI-powered applications, AI Agents, automation, and intelligent software systems.

Some of the projects I've worked on include a **Full-Stack E-Commerce Website**, a **Binance Market Terminal Website**, and a **Personal AI Assistant**. These projects have helped me improve my frontend, backend, database, API integration, and software development skills.

I also practice **Data Structures and Algorithms** to improve my problem-solving ability and prepare for software development opportunities. I enjoy exploring new technologies, building projects, and learning through practical development.

My goal is to become a **Software Engineer** specializing in Full-Stack Development and Artificial Intelligence, building useful, scalable, and intelligent applications while continuously improving my technical skills.

projects.title: Full-Stack E-Commerce Website
projects.description: A full-stack e-commerce website built with modern web technologies, featuring a responsive design, product catalog, shopping cart, and secure payment processing.

projects.title: Binance Market Terminal Website
projects.description: A real-time cryptocurrency market terminal for Binance, providing users with up-to-date price information, trading charts, and market analysis tools. Built with a modern frontend and robust backend infrastructure.

projects.title: Personal AI Assistant
projects.description: A personal AI assistant built with modern web technologies, featuring natural language processing, intelligent task management, and seamless integration with popular productivity tools. Designed to enhance user efficiency and provide a personalized experience.

roadmap.description: Started my B.Tech journey in Computer Science Engineering and learned programming fundamentals, problem-solving, object-oriented programming, and basic data structures.
Started building web applications and developed a strong foundation in frontend development, Python backend development, databases, and web fundamentals.

Expanded into full-stack development by learning React, Django, REST APIs, and database management. Built practical projects and improved my understanding of backend development and software architecture.
Focused on building full-stack applications and exploring Artificial Intelligence, AI Agents, automation, and API integration while continuing to improve my DSA and software development skills.

My goal is to become a Software Engineer specializing in Full-Stack Development and Artificial Intelligence, building scalable web applications, intelligent AI systems, and practical software solutions.
